message: evil/other is a Composer plugin that config.allow-plugins in composer.json does not list, so Composer asks whether to run it, and a run without a terminal (CI) fails; depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Review the plugin: add composer:evil/other to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json if the project needs it, or to installScripts.deny if it works without it, then run depcurfew apply

message: evil/plugin is a Composer plugin, whose code runs during Composer commands, and "evil/plugin" in config.allow-plugins in composer.json lets Composer run it, but depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Review the plugin and add composer:evil/plugin to installScripts.allow in depcurfew.json, or set it to false in config.allow-plugins of composer.json

message: odd plugin/x is a Composer plugin that config.allow-plugins in composer.json does not list, so Composer asks whether to run it, and a run without a terminal (CI) fails; depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Check the plugin at line 47 of composer.lock: its name "odd plugin/x" is not a Composer package name (lowercase vendor/name), so depcurfew.json cannot list it; remove the entry and lock again with composer update
